title: Agent Manifest
description: Machine-readable definition of an Agent Platform expert agent

id.description: Unique agent identifier matching the filename without extension

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in routing status prefix (▶ {display_name} expert)

capabilities.description: Domains and actions this agent is qualified to perform

cannot_do.description: Domains explicitly outside this agent's scope — routing will not send these here

critic_dimensions.description: Which Critic review dimensions apply when this agent's work is reviewed

requires_architect_for.description: Task types that require Architect agent sign-off before this agent proceeds

always_runs_security_gate.description: If true, security gate runs on every task regardless of endpoint/auth involvement

routing_keywords.description: Representative trigger phrases — used by routing table and surfaced in QUICK-REF

trust_ceiling.description: Maximum privilege tier this agent can operate at

reputation_capabilities.description: Capability keys tracked separately in reputation.json for per-domain trust scoring
